description.value: Cordo Resto & Bar is a regionally-inspired full-service restaurant and bar in downtown Kamloops, named after the Cordillera mountain geography of interior BC, offering indoor and outdoor patio dining. The menu celebrates Thompson-Okanagan regional cuisine with locally sourced produce, craft beers on tap, wines from the Kamloops Wine Trail and Okanagan, and house-crafted cocktails. A dedicated Grab + Go counter — a 'we proudly serve' Starbucks location — offers nutritious packaged meals and premium coffee for cyclists needing a quick, fuelling stop.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 84m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is comprehensive and confirms an active full-service restaurant at 540 Victoria St, Kamloops. Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('open for indoor & outdoor dining, take-out & delivery') and the Grab + Go section confirms packaged meals in environmentally-responsible packaging suited for cycling ('perfect for an early departure, working lunch or a picnic in the park'). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null; GF is confirmed by one recipe noted as 'gluten free' on the recipes subpage.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone number; both sourced solely from website (540 Victoria St, Kamloops, B.C.; 778-471-8035) — contact_confirmed fields for phone and address set to null.
All three required WWC criteria are unconfirmed; recommend outreach to the business to verify before listing.
